Sam: Hey team — first day with the M2 MacBook. Trying to enroll an Okta passkey via Chrome but it says "No compatible authenticator found". Also 1Password desktop won't finish provisioning. Anyone seen this?
Jamie-IT: Hey Sam, welcome! Can you confirm you're using the company Chrome profile? Personal profiles often block SSO/passkey flows.
Sam: How do I check which profile I'm on? The installer didn't pop anything obvious.
Jamie-IT: Click the avatar in the top-right -> Manage profiles. Should show 'Redwood — sam@redwood.com'. If you aren't signed into the company profile, sign in with Google SSO (company account).
Sam: It only shows 'Sam (Personal)'. When I try to create a new profile and sign in with SSO I get stuck on the Okta page and it just reloads the signin.
okta-bot: [system] Okta device enrollment failed for sam@redwood.com — auth request timed out.
Jamie-IT: @Alex-PeopleOps can you confirm SCIM/seat provisioning for Sam? If the org seat isn't active, 1Password will block the desktop flow.
Alex-PeopleOps: SCIM shows Sam active in group 'engineering' and a 1Password seat is assigned. No provisioning errors on our side.
Jamie-IT: Ok. Try clearing Chrome site data for okta/1password pages: DevTools -> Application -> Clear storage -> check Cookies + LocalStorage -> Clear site data, then try SSO again.
Sam: Cleared, retried — still looping. Console error when I click the passkey prompt: "Failed to create credentials: NotAllowedError".
Lorenzo-Sec: NotAllowedError usually means the browser blocked the authenticator UI or an extension interfered. Did you install any privacy/extension blockers? Also check that you didn't start Chrome with any flags like --disable-web-security.
Sam: I did have 'PrivacyGuard' installed. Disabled it and restarted Chrome. The passkey modal popped right up after that. Scanned the QR and could enroll the passkey.
Sam: One remaining issue: 1Password desktop still shows "No seats available" when I try to sign in via the app.
Alex-PeopleOps: The desktop app expects the web SSO flow to finish in the browser first. After passkey/SSO completes in the browser, the desktop app should auto-complete sign-in. Did you finish the web vault redirect?
Sam: Yes — I got redirected to the 1password.com web vault and I can see my org vault there. I opened the desktop app and it auto-signed in. Working now :tada:
Jamie-IT: Great. Short notes for the onboarding doc: 1) Use company Chrome profile for SSO/passkey flows, 2) disable privacy/blocking extensions during initial SSO enrollments, 3) desktop apps like 1Password often require the browser SSO flow to finish first. If anyone hits a weird loop, ping #eng-oncall or IT. Welcome aboard :wave:
Sam: Thanks everyone — saved my morning. Leaving this thread here in case we want to add the troubleshooting steps to the new-hires checklist.
